shaniwar_wada.name: Shaniwar Wada
shaniwar_wada.description: Historic 18th-century fortification seat of the Peshwa rulers of the Maratha Empire, famed for its massive Dilli Darwaza and fountain gardens.
shaniwar_wada.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Morning or late afternoon)

aga_khan_palace.name: Aga Khan Palace
aga_khan_palace.description: Majestic Italian-arched palace built in 1892, serving as a pivotal freedom movement monument where Mahatma Gandhi and Kasturba Gandhi were interned.

sinhagad_fort.name: Sinhagad Fort
sinhagad_fort.description: Legendary hill fortress perched on the Sahyadri ridge, famed for Tanaji Malusare's heroic battle, misty viewpoints, and authentic Kanda Bhaji.

dagdusheth_ganpati.name: Shreemant Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple
dagdusheth_ganpati.description: One of Maharashtra's most revered Ganesha shrines, adorned with ornate gold ornaments and drawing millions of devotees during Ganeshotsav.
dagdusheth_ganpati.best_time_to_visit: Throughout the year (Early mornings or during Ganeshotsav)

pataleshwar_caves.name: Pataleshwar Cave Temple
pataleshwar_caves.description: 8th-century Rashtrakuta-era monolithic rock-cut cave temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, featuring an iconic circular Nandi mandapa.

raja_kelkar_museum.name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
raja_kelkar_museum.description: Enthralling collection of over 20,000 rare Indian artifacts, medieval weaponry, musical instruments, and a replica of Mastani Mahal.

parvati_hill.name: Parvati Hill & Temple
parvati_hill.description: Scenic hillock rising 2,100 feet above sea level with 103 stone steps leading to ancient Peshwa temples and panoramic city vistas.

saras_baug.name: Saras Baug
saras_baug.description: Picturesque 25-acre garden featuring lush lawns, a dried lake bed turned park, and the celebrated Talyatla Ganpati temple.

shinde_chhatri.name: Shinde Chhatri
shinde_chhatri.description: Exquisite memorial dedicated to Maratha commander Mahadji Shinde, showcasing Rajasthani and Anglo-Indian stone craftsmanship.

osho_teerth_park.name: Osho Teerth Park
osho_teerth_park.description: Serene Japanese-style Zen garden transformed from a nullah into a tranquil oasis with bamboo groves, streams, and walking paths.

chaturshringi_temple.name: Chaturshringi Temple
chaturshringi_temple.description: Hillside temple dedicated to Goddess Chaturshringi (representing power and faith), set on a 90-foot hill with over 100 stone steps.

rajiv_gandhi_zoological_park.name: Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park & Snake Park
rajiv_gandhi_zoological_park.description: Sprawling 130-acre wildlife sanctuary housing tigers, leopards, diverse avian species, and a world-renowned reptile rescue center.

pune_okayama_friendship_garden.name: Pune-Okayama Friendship Garden (Pu La Deshpande)
pune_okayama_friendship_garden.description: Magnificent Japanese stroll garden inspired by Okayama's Korakuen Garden, adorned with natural canals, wooden bridges, and manicured lawns.

national_war_museum.name: National War Memorial Southern Command
national_war_museum.description: Sole citizen-funded war memorial in South Asia, honoring post-independence martyrs with displays of MIG-23 fighters, tanks, and naval guns.

khadakwasla_dam.name: Khadakwasla Dam
khadakwasla_dam.description: Scenic reservoir on the Mutha River bordering the National Defence Academy, beloved for sunset panoramas, roasted corn, and cool breezes.

lal_mahal.name: Lal Mahal
lal_mahal.description: Reconstructed red brick palace where Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj spent his childhood and famously defeated Mughal general Shaista Khan.

vishrambaug_wada.name: Vishrambaug Wada
vishrambaug_wada.description: Fine 1807 Maratha mansion built by Peshwa Bajirao II, distinguished by ornate teakwood facade, carved pillars, and courtyards.

fergusson_college.name: Fergusson College Campus
fergusson_college.description: Iconic Victorian-Gothic heritage educational campus established in 1885 by Bal Gangadhar Tilak and Gopal Krishna Gokhale.

empress_garden.name: Empress Botanical Garden
empress_garden.description: Historic 39-acre British botanical park housing centuries-old tropical trees, rare flora collections, and annual flower festivals.

iskcon_nvcc.name: ISKCON NVCC Pune
iskcon_nvcc.description: Colossal Vedic cultural center and Radha Vrindavanchandra temple at Kondhwa, celebrated for architectural splendor and vegetarian dining.

bund_garden.name: Bund Garden (Mahatma Gandhi Udyan)
bund_garden.description: Peaceful riverbank park built alongside the Mula-Mutha dam barrage by Sir Jamsetjee Jejeebhoy, popular for morning jogs and family strolls.

taljai_hills.name: Taljai Hills & Forest Reserve
taljai_hills.description: Lush green hill plateau rich in bio-diversity, home to peacocks, migratory birds, and paved jogging tracks amid dense woodland.

joshis_museum_railways.name: Joshi's Museum of Miniature Railways
joshis_museum_railways.description: Fascinating working miniature train layout featuring tiny locomotives, switch stations, automated signals, steam engines, and night light sequences.

pashan_lake.name: Pashan Lake & Bird Sanctuary
pashan_lake.description: British-built artificial lake attracting migratory waterfowl, featuring a perimeter nature bamboo walkway and sunset viewpoints.

phoenix_marketcity_pune.name: Phoenix Marketcity Pune
phoenix_marketcity_pune.description: One of Pune's premier lifestyle and entertainment mega-malls, hosting international retail brands, multiplex cinema, and gourmet dining.

tulsi_baug.name: Tulsi Baug Traditional Market
tulsi_baug.description: Historic bazaar buzzing with authentic Maharashtrian brassware, traditional attire, and the revered 18th-century Ram temple sanctum.

savitribai_phule_pune_university.name: Savitribai Phule Pune University
savitribai_phule_pune_university.description: The Oxford of the East spread across 411 green acres, featuring the iconic Italian-Gothic Main Building with a 100-foot clock tower.

kasba_ganapati.name: Kasba Ganapati Temple
kasba_ganapati.description: The patron deity (Gramadaivat) of Pune, commissioned by Rajmata Jijabai in 1639, holding the first place in Pune's Ganeshotsav immersions.

vetal_tekdi.name: Vetal Tekdi (ARAI Hill)
vetal_tekdi.description: The highest elevation point within Pune city limits at 2,600 feet, offering lush nature walks, birdwatching, and 360-degree skyline views.

bapdev_ghat.name: Bapdev Ghat Viewpoint
bapdev_ghat.description: Scenic mountain pass south of Pune connecting to Saswad, celebrated for dramatic valley vistas, monsoon greenery, and sunset drives.

st_marys_church_pune.name: St. Mary's Church
st_marys_church_pune.description: Oldest Anglican church in the Deccan region, consecrated in 1825 in Pune Camp, featuring stained-glass lancets and pipe organ.

mulshi_dam.name: Mulshi Dam & Lake
mulshi_dam.description: Enchanting hydro reservoir nestled deep in the Western Ghats, renowned for cascading monsoon waterfalls, mist, and lakeside eco-resorts.

panshet_dam.name: Panshet Dam (Tanajisagar)
panshet_dam.description: Vast earthen reservoir on the Ambi River popular for water sports, speed boating, kayaking, and rural Konkan-style excursions.

dehu_temple.name: Sant Tukaram Gatha Mandir (Dehu)
dehu_temple.description: Hallowed pilgrimage sanctum on the banks of Indrayani River where Saint Tukaram lived, featuring thousands of carved abhangas on marble.

alandi_temple.name: Sant Dnyaneshwar Samadhi Mandir (Alandi)
alandi_temple.description: Venerated resting place of Saint Dnyaneshwar who penned the Dnyaneshwari, drawing lakhs of Warkari pilgrims on the annual Palkhi procession.
alandi_temple.best_time_to_visit: October to March (And Kartika Vadya Ekadashi)

appu_ghar.name: Appu Ghar Amusement Park
appu_ghar.description: Pune's pioneer amusement park situated in Nigdi, featuring roller coasters, bumper cars, giant wheels, and leafy lake views.

bird_valley_udyan.name: Bird Valley Udyan (Chinchwad)
bird_valley_udyan.description: Vibrant lakeside recreational park in Chinchwad featuring pedal boating, musical fountains, green jogging tracks, and childrens play areas.

diamond_parks_lohegaon.name: Diamond Parks (Water & Adventure)
diamond_parks_lohegaon.description: Large-scale adventure and water entertainment hub near Lohegaon, boasting 28 waterslides, wave pools, zipline courses, and obstacle tracks.

blades_of_glory_museum.name: Blades of Glory Cricket Museum
blades_of_glory_museum.description: World's largest cricket museum recognized by Guinness World Records, displaying over 50,000 autographed bats, balls, and jerseys from global legends.

someshwar_wadi_temple.name: Someshwar Wadi Shiva Temple
someshwar_wadi_temple.description: Centuries-old stone temple built during the reign of Shivaji Maharaj along the Ramnadi stream, featuring classic Hemadpanthi masonry.

mahatma_phule_mandai.name: Mahatma Phule Mandai
mahatma_phule_mandai.description: Monumental 1886 Gothic wholesale retail market topped with an 80-foot stone tower and eight radial wings buzzing with fresh produce.

durga_tekdi.name: Durga Tekdi Park (Nigdi)
durga_tekdi.description: Extensively afforested hill park in PCMC boasting over 160,000 planted trees, serene waterfalls, lawn mounds, and cool evening breezes.

pimpri_chinchwad_science_park.name: Pimpri Chinchwad Science Park
pimpri_chinchwad_science_park.description: Interactive non-formal science centre featuring hands-on physics galleries, life-sized dinosaur park, 3D science show, and inflatable planetarium.

mula_mutha_sangam.name: Sangam Ghat (Mula-Mutha Confluence)
mula_mutha_sangam.description: Sacred confluence point of the Mula and Mutha rivers flanked by historic stone ghats and old temples, steeped in Peshwa heritage.

gram_sanskruti_udyan.name: Gram Sanskruti Udyan (Village Art Park)
gram_sanskruti_udyan.description: Pioneering mock village theme park in Pashan showcasing over 700 life-sized statues depicting traditional rural Maharashtrian occupations and customs.

bedse_caves.name: Bedse Buddhist Rock-Cut Caves
bedse_caves.description: Quiet 1st-century BCE Buddhist cave monastery boasting an imposing Chaitya hall with carved animal-crowned pillars and tranquil hillside views.

tribal_research_museum.name: Tribal Research Museum Pune
tribal_research_museum.description: Enlightening museum dedicated to Maharashtra's indigenous tribes (Bhil, Gond, Warli, Madia), showcasing traditional tribal masks, instruments, and handicrafts.

shri_balaji_temple_ketkawale.name: Sri Venkateshwara Temple (Prati Balaji Ketkawale)
shri_balaji_temple_ketkawale.description: Authentic full-scale replica of the Tirumala Tirupati Balaji Temple set in scenic Ketkawale, adhering to original temple rituals and serving laddoo prasad.

koregaon_park_lanes.name: Koregaon Park Cafes & Boulevard
koregaon_park_lanes.description: Pune's premier upscale cultural hub lined with banyan-canopied lanes, artisanal cafes, European bakeries, and chic art spaces.

symbiosis_vishwa_bhavan.name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Museum & Memorial (Symbiosis)
symbiosis_vishwa_bhavan.description: Dignified memorial at Senapati Bapat Road housing personal belongings, Bharat Ratna citation, violin, and rare manuscripts of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.
